Nd.source: Antic-Fidancev, Holsa, Lemaitre-Blaise and Porcher, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 3, 6829 (1991), doi 10.1088/0953-8984/3/35/012
Nd.locator: Table 2, p. 6836 (pdf p. 9), NdPO4 experimental column
Nd.note: All five 4I9/2 doublets observed in pure NdPO4. Added 2026-10-24, still before any LnPO4 thermal data were read.

Eu.source: Dexpert-Ghys, Mauricot and Faucher, J. Lumin. 69, 203 (1996), doi 10.1016/S0022-2313(96)00094-4
Eu.note: Site C1, all singlets. 7F1 is the excited multiplet the rule requires; 7F2 is included as measured. Which lines are electronic was decided with the authors' crystal-field analysis (p. 211).

Gd.source: none needed: 8S7/2 splits by under 1 cm-1, one eight-fold level (the rule's built-in check)

Tb.source: Loong, Soderholm, Goodman, Abraham and Boatner, Phys. Rev. B 48, 6124 (1993), doi 10.1103/PhysRevB.48.6124
Tb.method: inelastic neutron scattering, 4.2 K and 15 K
Tb.note: Three levels not observed, taken from the paper's fit.

Dy.source: Loong, Soderholm, Xue, Abraham and Boatner, J. Alloys Compd. 207-208, 165 (1994), doi 10.1016/0925-8388(94)90198-8
Dy.locator: Fig. 2, p. 167 (pdf p. 3); observed peaks in the text, p. 166
Dy.note: The figure is the fitted scheme; its lower five levels equal the observed peaks (8.5 meV inferred from an asymmetric peak, 16 meV weak). 37.5 and 38.9 meV not observed.

Ho.source: Loong, Soderholm, Hammonds, Abraham, Boatner and Edelstein, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 5, 5121 (1993), doi 10.1088/0953-8984/5/29/009
Ho.locator: Table 2, p. 5134 (pdf p. 15), HoPO4 observed column c; fit column b (neutron plus optical)
Ho.note: G2 and G1 near 184 cm-1 are one unresolved peak, both given 184.3. Five levels from fit b.

Er.source: Loong, Soderholm, Hammonds, Abraham, Boatner and Edelstein, J. Phys.: Condens. Matter 5, 5121 (1993), doi 10.1088/0953-8984/5/29/009
Er.locator: Table 4, p. 5135 (pdf p. 16), neutron column; calculated column where not observed
Er.note: Raman (Becker 1985, 1986) puts the third G7 at 105 and the top G6 at 269; the authors keep the neutron assignment, followed here. Top two levels from the fit.

Tm.source: Loong, Soderholm, Abraham, Boatner and Edelstein, J. Chem. Phys. 98, 4214 (1993), doi 10.1063/1.465028
Tm.locator: Table II, p. 4219 (pdf p. 7), observed column; fit b where not observed
Tm.method: inelastic neutron scattering, 15 K and 100 K
Tm.note: 254.9 and the pair at 338.0 come from weak, unresolved 100 K features. G4 277.9 from the fit.

Yb.source: Loong, Loewenhaupt, Nipko, Braden and Boatner, Phys. Rev. B 60, R12549 (1999), doi 10.1103/PhysRevB.60.R12549
Yb.note: Peaks broadened and shifted by coupling to phonons; taken as measured (Michael's choice). The text gives the top level as ~43 meV on p. R12550 and about 45 meV on p. R12551; 43 used.
